prompt_replacements.old:
related_sets declares sets directly related to its parent set. Each item
declares the association or associations and the one set reached through them.
Its nested related_sets continues the graph from that newly declared set.
prompt_replacements.new: related_sets declares sets directly related to its parent set. Each item declares the association or associations and the one set reached through them. A set reserved by a shown grouping copies group_ref; every other set writes origin. Its nested related_sets continues the graph from that newly declared set.
